title: REQ · preload.test.ts proves planPreload dedup, unknown refs and resolveTextureKey fallback
summary: Planner and resolver behavior asserted in game/tests/preload.test.ts
description: Context: planPreload and resolveTextureKey in game/src/engine/planPreload.ts are pure. Desired behavior: they stay importable pure named exports and preload.test.ts asserts dedup, unknown reporting and fallback key. Expected result: those assertions pass with an in-memory manifest. Why: criteria of SG-5.4.3.
acceptance_criteria: Given two objects using asset A in the manifest, when planPreload runs, then load equals [A] and unknown is empty
Given object asset Z and dust asset Y not in the manifest, when planPreload runs, then unknown equals [Z, Y] and load is empty
Given unknown or undefined id, when resolveTextureKey runs with fallback fallback:missing, then it returns the fallback

preserve: planPreload and resolveTextureKey signatures and behavior

technical_constraints: Pure functions, no I/O, in-memory manifest
